data.text:
M/S. S.S. Acqua Industries, vs Food Safety And Standards
Authority Of ... on 28 August, 2024 
Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Writ Petition No.6378 of 2012
Order: 
Sri Chaitanya, learned counsel representing Sri P.Lakshma Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that the cause in the Writ Petition does not survive for consideration any more by this Court and that the Writ Petition has become infructuous. 
2. Recording the said submission, the Writ Petition is closed. No order as to costs. 
3. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
